age.evidence: 8-10 weeks old C57BL/6J male mice (supplied by Invigo Laboratories, Rehovot, Israel)

dosing.evidence: All compounds were dissolved in Phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) ... and administered i.p. in a volume of 200 μL. For studies of dose-dependent effect of psilobyin, separate mice were injected i.p. with 1 mg/kg, 3 mg/kg, or 5 mg/kg psilocybin, or PBS vehicle.
In ketanserin experiments, Mice were i.p. injected with 3 mg/kg ketanserin or PBS 30 min prior to i.p. injection with psilocybin or PBS.

group_housing.evidence: Mice were housed according to Federation of Laboratory Animal Science Associations (FELASA) guidelines (cage density not stated).

day_night_flipped.evidence: Mice were maintained in a vivarium at 22 C with a reversed light-cycle (lights on at 19:00 h, off at 07:00 h). ... Testing occurred between 9:00 and 16:00 h.

assays.assay_description: 50x50 cm Non-Glare Perspex square arena, 120 lux, 30 min session starting immediately after injection; total distance, time in center (25x25 cm), % distance in center, with 2-min time bins of center time. Run in psilocybin dose-response (0/1/3/5 mg/kg) and ketanserin (3 mg/kg) pretreatment experiments.

application_type.evidence: Mice were i.p. injected with the different treatments and immediately after administration mice were placed in a corner of a square arena

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were placed in a corner of a square arena made from a Non-Glare Perspex (50 x 50 cm)

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

time_to_assay.evidence: immediately after administration mice were placed in a corner of a square arena

sample_size.evidence: n = 12 (Figure 1 and Figure 3 legends; 4 groups in dose-response + 4 groups in ketanserin experiment)

outcomes.summary: 5 mg/kg psilocybin significantly decreased time in center and % distance moved in center compared with all other groups (1, 3 mg/kg, vehicle). Ketanserin pretreatment did not attenuate the psilocybin-induced reduction in center time.
outcomes.statistics: p < 0.05/0.01/0.001/0.0001 by two-way ANOVA and one-way ANOVA, followed by Tukey's multiple comparisons test (full ANOVA output in Table S2)
outcomes.evidence: In the open field, 5 mg/kg psilocybin induced a significant decrease in time in center, as well as in % distance moved in center, compared with all other experimental groups. ... There was no difference between the psilocybin-PBS and psilocybin-kentanserin group.

B1_num_measures.evidence: we measured total distance moved to evaluate locomotion and time in center (25 x 25 cm) to evaluate anxiety-like behavior; Percent total distance traveled in the center

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The test was carried out for 30 min and data are time bins of every 2 min within the 30 min.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only spatial/locomotor measures (distance, time in center).

B5_social.evidence: Individual open field testing; no social construct.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate avoidance anxiety test; no learning component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Mouse positioning and movement were analyzed by the Ethovision XT 10 (Noldus, Wageningen, The Netherlands) software.

E1_environment_type.evidence: square arena made from a Non-Glare Perspex (50 x 50 cm)

E2_shelter.evidence: Open square arena; no shelter described.

E3_bedding.evidence: Non-Glare Perspex arena; no bedding mentioned.

E6_spatial.evidence: square arena with virtual center zone (25 x 25 cm) only

E7_social_context.evidence: mice were placed in a corner of a square arena (individual testing)

E8_food_water.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

D5_followup.evidence: Testing only acutely after injection; no ≥24 h follow-up.

assays.assay_description: Small dark compartment connected via small hatch to larger compartment illuminated at 1200 lux; 5 min trial starting 15 min post-injection; time in light zone and entry zone. Dose-response and ketanserin pretreatment experiments.

application_type.evidence: Mice were i.p. injected with the different treatments and 15 min after administration mice were placed in a small dark compartment

setup_restrain.evidence: were allowed to cross through a small hatch into a larger compartment

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

time_to_assay.evidence: 15 min after administration mice were placed in a small dark compartment

outcomes.summary: All doses of psilocybin (1, 3, 5 mg/kg) significantly decreased time spent in the light zone compared to control. Ketanserin pretreatment did not attenuate this effect.
outcomes.statistics: p < 0.05/0.01/0.001/0.0001 by one-way/two-way ANOVA, followed by Tukey's multiple comparisons test
outcomes.evidence: In the dark-light test, all doses of psilocybin induced a significant decrease in time spent in light zone compared to control.

B1_num_measures.evidence: During the 5-min trial, time spent in the lighted zone and entry zone were measured

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total time in light zone in 5 min only.

E1_environment_type.evidence: dark-light box: small dark compartment and larger illuminated compartment

E2_shelter.evidence: mice were placed in a small dark compartment and were allowed to cross through a small hatch

E6_spatial.evidence: small dark compartment ... small hatch into a larger compartment illuminated with 1200 lux

E8_food_water.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

assays.assay_description: Elevated plus maze illuminated at 20 lux; 5 min trial starting 30 min post-injection; time in open arms, closed arms, center, and % distance in open arms. Dose-response and ketanserin pretreatment experiments.

application_type.evidence: Mice were i.p. injected with the different treatments and 30 min after administration mice were placed in the center of the elevated plus maze

setup_restrain.evidence: were allowed to roam between the closed and open arms

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

time_to_assay.evidence: 30 min after administration mice were placed in the center of the elevated plus maze

outcomes.summary: 3 and 5 mg/kg psilocybin significantly decreased time in open arms and % distance moved in open arms compared to 1 mg/kg and control. Ketanserin did not attenuate this effect.
outcomes.statistics: p < 0.05/0.01/0.001/0.0001 by one-way/two-way ANOVA, followed by Tukey's multiple comparisons test
outcomes.evidence: In the elevated plus maze, 3 mg/kg and 5 mg/kg psilocybin produced significant decrease in time spent in open arms and in % distance moved in open arms compared to 1 mg/kg and control.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Total time spent in open arms; Percent distance traveled in the open arms (Figure 1F-G)

E2_shelter.evidence: EPM closed arms are part of apparatus design, not a shelter (definitionally absent per rubric).

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM arms are open-ended extensions of a central platform (per rubric).

E8_food_water.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

assays.assay_description: 20x40 cm compartment with 5 cm clean bedding and 20 glass marbles (4x5 grid), dim light (20 lux); 30 min session starting 30 min post-injection; number of marbles buried (≥2/3 covered). Dose-response and ketanserin pretreatment experiments.

application_type.evidence: Mice were i.p. injected with the different treatments and 30 min after administration mice were placed in a compartment (20 x 40 cm).

setup_restrain.evidence: Each mouse was placed in the compartment and was given 30 min exploration period

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

time_to_assay.evidence: 30 min after administration mice were placed in a compartment

outcomes.summary: 3 and 5 mg/kg psilocybin significantly decreased the number of marbles buried compared with 1 mg/kg and control. Ketanserin did not affect this psilocybin-induced decrease.
outcomes.statistics: p < 0.05/0.01/0.001/0.0001 by one-way/two-way ANOVA, followed by Tukey's multiple comparisons test
outcomes.evidence: In the marble burying test, 3 mg/kg and 5 mg/kg psilocybin produced a significant decrease in marbles buried compared with 1 mg/kg and control. ... ketanserin did not affect the decrease in marble burying behavior caused by psilocybin.

B1_num_measures.evidence: the number of marbles buried, was counted

B4_ethological.evidence: Marble burying reflects natural digging/burying behaviour in bedding ('Buried' was defined as 2/3 covered by bedding).

B7_automated_classification.evidence: the number of marbles buried, was counted

E1_environment_type.evidence: placed in a compartment (20 x 40 cm)

E3_bedding.evidence: arranged in a 4 x 5 grid on top of 5 cm clean bedding

E5_enrichment.evidence: Marbles are the test stimuli, not enrichment.

E7_social_context.evidence: Each mouse was placed in the compartment

E8_food_water.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Marbles buried within 30 min period in marble burying test

assays.assay_description: Small compartment (15x7.5 cm), 120 lux, 15 min session starting immediately after psilocybin (5 mg/kg) injection with/without ketanserin (3 mg/kg) pretreatment; head twitches counted manually from iPad video.

application_type.evidence: Mice were i.p. injected with 3 mg/kg ketanserin or PBS 30 min prior to i.p. injection with psilocybin or PBS.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were placed in a small compartment (15 x 7.5 cm)

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately after psilocybin administration mice were placed in a small compartment

sample_size.evidence: n = 12 (Figure 3 legend; 4 groups: PBS-PBS, Ketan-PBS, PBS-Psi, Ketan-Psi)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (5 mg/kg) significantly increased head twitches; ketanserin pretreatment attenuated this increase, consistent with 5-HT2A mediation of HTR.
outcomes.statistics: p < 0.05/0.01/0.001/0.0001 by two-way ANOVA, followed by Tukey's multiple comparisons test
outcomes.evidence: Preinjection of mice with ketanserin attenuated the psilocybin-induced increase in head twitches. In other words, psilocybin-PBS group had significantly more head twitches than all other experimental groups, including the psilocybin-ketanserin group.

B1_num_measures.evidence: the videos were manually analyzed to measure the number of head twitch response performed by each mouse

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Number of head twitches in 15 min time period (total only).

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours per rubric.

E8_food_water.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum, except during behavioral testing.

judge_notes: All three candidates agreed on five assays (OFT, Dark-Light, EPM, Marble Burying, HTR); dose-response and ketanserin experiments collapsed into single assay entries per rubric. c-Fos IHC and phosphoproteomics excluded as non-behavioural.

OFT B1: three reported measures (total distance, time in center, % distance in center); time bins are the same measure, so 2-3 (score 1), overriding deepseek's 4-6 and gemma's inconsistent score 2 with value '2-3'.
Dark-Light and EPM B1 set to score 1 (2-3); gemma's score 2 was inconsistent with its own '2-3' value.
HTR B1 set to score 0 (single measure) and D2 set to score 1 (15 min falls in 15–60 min bin); gemma's values corrected.
Marble burying B4 = Yes (modal, 2/3 candidates; digging/burying in bedding), medium confidence.
application_type set to i.p. for all assays (modal); both psilocybin and ketanserin were given i.p., so 'multiple' (gemma) not warranted.

n_total: 96 for anxiety assays (4 dose-response groups + 4 ketanserin groups, n=12 each; methods indicate separate mice per test) and 48 for HTR (4 ketanserin groups); medium confidence since exact cohort overlap not stated.
day_night_flipped = yes: reversed cycle with lights off 07:00 and testing 09:00–16:00 (dark phase).
Added ketanserin as a separate dosing entry since it was a drug administered in behavioural experiments (3 mg/kg i.p., 30 min before psilocybin).
